data.case_title: Use prohibition for the basement room at Lennestraße 41
data.title: Use prohibition (Nutzungsuntersagung) for the basement room as residential space
data.summary: The Stadt Beispielhagen (Fachbereich Bauordnung) issued a decision on 18 November 2026 prohibiting Ilka Musterlenne from renting out the basement room at Lennestraße 41 as housing, because it lacks sufficient windows and a second emergency exit. A legal action (Klage) against this decision can be filed with the Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The city's building authority has formally forbidden letting the basement room as a residence because it does not meet legal requirements for habitable space (windows, emergency exit). No Widerspruch (objection) procedure applies here; instead, you may file a lawsuit (Klage) with the Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg if you want to contest this decision. The app will show the exact deadline based on when you received this letter. If you take no action, the prohibition stands and the room may not be used or rented as living space. Consider consulting a lawyer specialising in building law if you wish to challenge it.

key_facts.quote:
mit diesem Bescheid vom 18.11.2026 untersage ich Ihnen, den Kellerraum im Haus
Lennestraße 41 als Wohnung zu vermieten.

key_facts.label: Deadline to file a court action
key_facts.quote:

Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg, Jägerstraße 1, 59821 Musterarnsberg, erhoben werden; ein
Widerspruchsverfahren findet nicht statt.
